notes.title: September 2025 - Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Catching crayfish with a crayfish trap. [/p][/*][*][p]Information boards about the old church. [/p][/*][*][p]Player abilities will be improved after visiting the bathhouse. [/p][/*][*][p]Humidity inside the player's house. [/p][/*][*][p]Water texture has been changed for Low and Medium graphics settings. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the angle of the fishing rod when fighting a fish. [/p][/*][*][p]Added head inertia effects when operating various vehicles. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Catching crayfish with a crayfish trap[/h2][p][/p][p]A crayfish trap can be found at the campsite on the shore of Pastor's Lake. It's designed for catching crayfish in this lake.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/f41a45f14d363d766481895416f97ded951e95cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To begin fishing, place live bait—a previously caught carp or perch—inside the cage. When the live bait appears inside the crayfish trap, the device is ready for fishing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/83c2be025986feafe2be91246cd2428002bb1444.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Place the crayfish trap in the lake, completely submerging the cage. Your catch will depend on your chosen location, so look for the best catch spot. Crayfish typically live in burrows near the shore, under old snags, dead trees, and in shallow water.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/671271c7d59dcda0f020b9869e42cf886e68a568.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can also use a motorboat to transport your crayfish trap to remote parts of the lake. When you enter boat control mode, all items you're carrying will be secured inside the boat. Keep an eye on this, and if any items fall into the water during loading, retrieve them if they float.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/609a97fec5d93a631d2ff751304378848617fc26.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Caught crayfish can be sold at the market along with other fish.[/p][p]An achievement has been added for catching a crayfish for the first time.[/p][p][/p][h2]Information boards about the old church[/h2][p][/p][p]In preparation for the first story mission, information boards detailing the church's history were installed. You can view them either at the church itself on the hill, or at the first exit leading up to the road.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/dbd066fae3914aacb407d5a59327dc134dcd5380.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Player stats changes after visiting the bathhouse[/h2][p][/p][p]Now, after visiting the bathhouse, the player receives a temporary increase to running speed of +30%, in addition to the existing bonus to the amount of HP.[/p][p][/p][h2]Humidity inside the player's house[/h2][p][/p][p]Microclimate monitoring has been implemented for the player's home. If the room remains unheated for a long time, it becomes damp and harbors dangerous microorganisms. To combat this, the room must be heated periodically; otherwise, the player may begin coughing and suffer -1 HP damage every few seconds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/227e7e3905d0a9baa5d7128f13ae1ee660116b2c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/5dd4a90f37c631cfffd9bc7fe79f748a175e896a.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Water texture has been changed for Low and Medium graphics settings[/h2][p][/p][p]Due to the water being too dark and reflections being disabled in Low and Medium graphics settings, the water texture has been replaced with a lighter one for these scenarios.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/c0a27262f70a8f6254fee635ffeacd7bb24ddba9.png"][/img][/p][h2]Reduced the angle of the fishing rod when fighting a fish[/h2][p][/p][p]To achieve a more natural behaviour of the rod, the bending angle under load has been reduced.[/p][p][/p][h2]Added head inertia effects when operating various vehicles[/h2][p][/p][p]During sudden acceleration, braking, and sharp turns, the player's head moves slightly.[/p]

notes.title: August 2025 - Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Working on logging[/p][/*][*][p]Growing tomatoes[/p][/*][*][p]Added reflections in mirrors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Working on logging[/h3][p][/p][p]The player can work on logging. Cut trees can be handed over to the storage and then made into a package of firewood. The packages of firewood can be used to fill the storage for firewood in the player's house.[/p][p]To logging, you need to take a saw with you. With its help, you can switch to chainsaw mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/2c80a952c82cf977d6de9593417483ad99d491c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When you go to a logging site, you can cut down trees marked with a red piece of cloth.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/cf3d5348eea0d17fa3e128d3e4e975b0b26bc2b7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Switch to chainsaw mode and cut down the tree. (The tree near the player's house is shown as an example)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/4063930a73d2956ce5ce758259302664b3310d6c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Take the tree trunks to the storage facility at the sawmill.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/0181c4ec95755ae1ba46ccf8c8c0d8365d897bc9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]One trunk can be used to make a pack of firewood (20 pieces).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/09a87e18771927931dce875fe284e97212210aed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deliver these packages to the player's storage near the house, so that later you can use the firewood to light the stove inside the house or in the built bathhouse.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/a85ab8f8eeef6dfcf5fafb86447adc5745145826.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over time, trees that have been cut down will grow back and will be available for harvesting again.[/p][p]You can also sell firewood at your local store.[/p][p][/p][h3]Growing tomatoes[/h3][p][/p][p]There is a greenhouse with tomatoes in the player's yard.[/p][p]To collect them, you need to use boxes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/68fddbb62401cdf9200ad649fe6370a79e7e061b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/4e36b7c2aa02f10ef2677ddf16c40d181ae9b69a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once a full box has been collected, the harvest can be sold at a local store.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/6e1f7881fa7b890577e1ae99cc937ec7c9fb5eac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When the harvest is collected, the beds need to be watered to ripen new tomatoes. Growth will begin with the first watering and will be completed in 10 days. To speed up the process to 5 days, you need to water the beds every day.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/65ec0a2d5f6bd0082eed218f209169bd256d6014.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/8a78280ab0c3f9723a67039926fc0c1c619b6094.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Added reflections in mirrors[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/09c74119c8d9f24b70b95355ff21fafdfa8bd750.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/c9d5671d648f525ec81630be1c9441e436ea181f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/fc0615d8704833f04a0b93d5b28364982c2bb2ab.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: July 2025 - Update #2
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added the ability to cook and eat mushrooms[/p][/*][*][p]Added a roof rack for 4x4[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added the ability to cook and eat mushrooms[/h3][p][/p][p]After collecting edible mushrooms, you can take the available number of mushrooms from your inventory for subsequent cooking.[/p][p]You can take the mushroom from the inventory in the player's house above the fireplace (one mushroom at a time)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/1927b01f50b03d504fdb1813eaaac2332f51c2e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Afterwards, like other items (fish, toast bread and more in the future) it can be cooked on heated surfaces such as a frying pan on the stove.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/0c25cbd72f77e86915fb505ef8745118e8538e09.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After frying, the mushroom can be eaten. Eating replenishes life and hunger levels and indirectly affects the thirst scale and urine accumulation.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/fa438cd82282d608350db916fb75ff265343926b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Added roof rack 4x4[/h3][p][/p][p]To transport more cargo, a roof rack has been added to the all-wheel drive SUV.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/889b802dfe75d93b4ec38ed3c9e99ee8dceb9921.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Any objects that the player can carry with his hands can be placed there. When getting into the car, the objects will be automatically fixed to the trunk (without visualization).[/p]

notes.title: June 2025 - Update. Region progress system
notes.content: [list][*][p]Multi-level progression system in the region (task system)[/p][/*][*][p]Possibility to destruct mushrooms[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Multi-level progression system in the region[/h3][p]This update introduces a hierarchical system of tasks. At the lowest level are the tasks of neighbors - households within the village. For completing all the tasks of neighbors, the village progress becomes 50%. To fully complete the progress of the village, in addition to the lower tasks, you need to complete the tasks of the village itself.[/p][p]All villages will be united into a region - its progression will also consist of 50% of the tasks of the lower level + 50% for completing all global tasks. Briefly, the progression scheme is presented in this diagram:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/ac2457e6da98bf24bd5eb4ff12553b0759597e6e.png"][/img][/p][p]Information about the task list can be found near the neighbors' gate.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/7d6e5bf448f5646af703a497291136e4764fdc25.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The overall progress of the village is presented on the back of the information board.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/6c9f9f5f2708b9d1c98523fceb8b4b5a2e796b5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For completing all regional tasks, it is planned to introduce in-game rewards in the form of improvements, unique vehicles or household items.[/p][p]At the moment, tasks have been introduced only for the village at the starting location - SNT Sosnovskoye.[/p][p]In the following updates, new tasks and levels will be gradually introduced.[/p][p][/p][h3]Possibility of destruction of mushrooms[/h3][p][/p][p]Now in mushroom picking mode (with the basket on) you can also destroy mushrooms.[/p][p]To do this, press the T button[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/947da2c6d8ece7025cd18b25b7a1ef9bccba34f6.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: May 2025 - Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] City. Preliminary version
[*] Working in a taxi. Buying a license
[*] New types of fines for violations
[/list]

[h1]City. Preliminary version[/h1]

The first version of the satellite town "Sosnovy Bor" is presented. Road signs (not far from the gas station) will help you explore the road to it.

Over time, the city will be expanded and reworked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/1f99695242acb7ebc63445703165a1a804ddd5ee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/047d3bab1d159c61834ffc4e7917f28ac529b1e8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/647c4b0e4c68db75e7372ca3a16f1194b214ad69.png[/img]

To replenish the scale of needs, there are still water pumps and a store at the gas station to buy drinks and snacks. You can also fill up there at a lower price than in the village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/a10d06222015412070e767eefde7285411762ae2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/944e669aebc8c03395084ef9e9fa741e8bfd2839.jpg[/img]

There is a free bus running around the city 24 hours a day. You can take a ride on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/da009d0d871b72fe14023e64196ea857bdabeda7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/b957d521841ea38724f199179909c28fe91600bc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Working in a taxi. Buying a license[/h1]

After purchasing a WLG-24 car, you will be able to purchase a taxi license and carry out passenger transportation orders. Look for a yellow car with a leaflet. The license is paid, so check your wallet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/8f6625a96eb57dc32ea1b3049a3da0f800aee065.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/b957d521841ea38724f199179909c28fe91600bc.jpg[/img]

After purchasing a license, a special mode will open for WLG-24, pressing the Enter button will activate the taxi task and the player will start receiving orders.

Distance, pick-up/drop-off address, total earnings are shown in the UI, and the destination is also shown on the radar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/c7f6a3e9e50c269f8a023962f47388ff486e11ea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/26da3e076e4c7c17e88f61cd3207b9cc02660768.jpg[/img]

[h1]New types of fines for violations[/h1]

There is only one controlled intersection in the city so far. For driving through a red light, the player will receive a fine. If the player does not have enough money to pay, the vehicle will be towed to the impound lot, from which it can only be picked up after paying the fine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/cc62cea3bf9e52bc6abd2f2fd94695ab71aa9e47.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/4b97e8c83568927b59cb4d147d2e102a3a20f562.jpg[/img]

notes.title: April 2025 - Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a small chicken coop in the player's yard
[*] Added a point for buying items from the player
[*] Added a cage with animals (chickens) for purchase
[/list]

[h1]Added a small chicken coop in the player's yard[/h1]

The player's yard now has a small chicken coop for 10 chickens. Chickens can lay eggs that can be sold in the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/bb83cc46ecfd2e06062909d2ad7acf21155384f9.jpg[/img]

In order to avoid interruptions in the production of chicken eggs, it is necessary to monitor the level of feed and water for animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/cb05919e15c46e3af80915fc2375132e36ef49eb.jpg[/img]

To refill, you need to buy food in the store and fill the water barrel with water using a bucket. The barrels are filled when the bucket/food touches the barrel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/b014e4e3aca9b10bd8c080e30ea38c4e45ceb8da.jpg[/img]

The food is sold at the local store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/028bf54a369b0b36baca18e87fb888c198aaa255.jpg[/img]

Eggs appear within 15 minutes of real-time in-game near resource barrels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/75c185713151a3aa536114a72a99ad965fd81952.jpg[/img]

They can be picked up and delivered to the store for sale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/ce84d1b71541308907833c5c6f95ac1155d84405.jpg[/img]

[h1]Added a point for buying items from the player[/h1]

Now you can sell the produced products (eggs, other unclaimed products with a price reduction) in the local store. It is enough to put the products for sale inside the marker, after a few seconds (15) the store will take the products and pay the player money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/61976ed1a300a6be966b7c63c561acac9b782456.jpg[/img]

[h1]Added a cage with animals (chicken) for purchase[/h1]

You can buy a cage with animals at the market. To populate them, just bring the cage to the chicken coop and lower it onto the roof. The maximum possible number of chickens is 10.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/79acba4104833f5c54b1c4935ebc31a27b7eb87b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/436c99569f04e250a4064acdce83450f0bdefad4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/38548fb924141a51816b50c4bffb8b0cde6523ff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: March 2025 - Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] WLG-24 serviced vehicle
[*] WLG-24 dashboard
[*] WLG-24 Maintenance
[/list]

One of the vehicles available for purchase by the player in the game is the WLG-24. This is a production vehicle from the late 60s, which was intended at one time for use by mid-level government officials in some countries.

The car has a long wheelbase, has a gasoline engine, and is characterized by fairly high fuel consumption. The model presented in the game was modified by a local "craftsman" and therefore has excellent acceleration and traction characteristics, but has a low maximum speed and is prone to overheating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/50c0c2d3d1e2d364c9fd447d4ae0fdf97aadb02b.jpg[/img]

[b]WLG-24 dashboard[/b]

The dashboard featured analogue gauges and indicators typical of that time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/ff20931fb74120a384a9bd2f02d394ba4031f908.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Speedometer
[*] Odometer (total mileage counter)
[*] Oil pressure indicator
[*] Coolant temperature indicator (WATER)
[*] Fuel level indicator in the tank
[*] Clock
[/list]

Always monitor the fuel level and engine temperature. If the engine overheats, the radiator cooling fan will operate to reduce the temperature, but if you continue driving intensively, the coolant may boil. If the water boils out of the radiator, a situation may arise in which the engine will temporarily seize due to overheating and stall. Further movement will be possible only after the engine has cooled to operating temperature.
 
[b]WLG-24 Maintenance[/b]

Maintenance of WLG-24 consists of timely replacement of engine oil and replacement/control of the coolant (WATER) level in the radiator.
Recommended interval for replacement of engine oil is 5000 km.

The need for an oil change can be determined by increased fuel consumption and a change in the color of the exhaust gases from neutral gray to dark black.

All technical fluids can be purchased at your local store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/9f1a177a3dece82b8b35e5c10d01ddef4c1dd188.jpg[/img]

To replace the oil and water in the radiator, you need to drain the old fluids. The best place for this is an inspection pit in one of the villages or in a garage cooperative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/74e2c41c3337fe1499446d10687fab234f865a70.jpg[/img]

To drain, simply unscrew the drain plug. No special tool is needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/67b60eb2f09615975c1537f3806eb4bff5baf835.jpg[/img]

To fill the fluids, you need to remove the plugs in the engine compartment and bring the purchased oils or fluids to the plug.
The filling level can be checked in the inspection pit by hovering the cursor over the drain plug.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/3f6ea93c2e161af193a048caada31b3cf30bfbf9.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
Now in Pastor’s Lake you can interact with NPC characters – residents of the village and surrounding areas. Chat, help or just learn about life in this secluded corner of nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/c37c90cd246c8f50663cbe8d844018305f9c4888.jpg[/img]

The first story mission (prologue) has been added, which will introduce you to the history of the Shepherd's Lake and the old abandoned church. Find out why this place is so important to the locals, what secrets its walls hide, and how you can influence the fate of this corner of the village. This is only the beginning of a great story!

[h1]Sauna for rent[/h1]

Now, if a player has a sauna built in their yard, they can earn money by renting it out through an aggregator. The aggregator stand is located in the store. Daily earnings accumulate up to 10,000 banknotes, then the accumulation is suspended until the player takes the money. You can collect money daily at the aggregator stand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/6f32d22294bd2a379cef7e0565ffe038e7d3efe2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/9a1ddab6b0bcdb3418b0af61e0889a64288b4f99.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827459/063826aaa07a67b2f7a02589db72f864270325e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pyrotechnic explosions now deal damage to the player[/h1]

Now pyrotechnic explosions can cause damage to the player if the explosion was close to the player. And if a player can survive a small explosion only with the loss of a significant percentage of health, then explosions of large firecrackers can kill the player instantly.
